name: pin01_0928_morning_marcus
author: Marcus Aurelius
text: At dawn, when you have trouble getting out of bed, tell yourself: I have to go to work - as a human being.

name: pin02_0928_stoic_marcus
author: Marcus Aurelius
text: The impediment to action advances action. What stands in the way becomes the way.

name: pin03_0928_hard_seneca
author: Seneca
text: We suffer more often in imagination than in reality.

name: pin04_0929_bible_joshua
author: Joshua 1:9
text: Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed: for the LORD thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.

name: pin05_0929_morning_horace
author: Horace
text: He who has begun is half done. Dare to be wise; begin!

name: pin06_0930_stoic_epictetus
author: Epictetus
text: Men are disturbed not by the things which happen, but by the opinions about the things.

name: pin07_0930_morning_laotzu
author: Lao Tzu
text: A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.

name: pin08_1001_morning_seneca
author: Seneca
text: While we are postponing, life speeds by.

name: pin09_1001_bible_lamentations
author: Lamentations 3:22-23
text: It is of the LORD's mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not. They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.

name: pin10_1002_stoic_seneca
author: Seneca
text: It is not that we have a short time to live, but that we waste a lot of it.

name: pin11_1002_hard_marcus
author: Marcus Aurelius
text: If you are distressed by anything external, the pain is not due to the thing itself, but to your estimate of it; and this you have the power to revoke at any moment.

name: pin12_1003_bible_matthew
author: Matthew 11:28
text: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.

name: pin13_1003_stoic_marcus
author: Marcus Aurelius
text: Waste no more time arguing about what a good man should be. Be one.

name: pin14_1004_bible_isaiah
author: Isaiah 40:31
text: But they that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint.

name: pin15_1004_hard_psalm
author: Psalms 46:1
text: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
